name: Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce
author: Easy Payment

sections.description:
🚀 Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for Woocommerce allows you to accept payments through Razorpay UPI, Wallet, Cards, and Net Banking, providing customers with a quick and secure checkout experience. Developed by an Official Razorpay Partner, this plugin ensures high performance and reliability.

Key Features:

  • Multiple Payment Options: Accept payments via UPI, Wallet, Cards, and Net Banking.
  • Seamless Checkout: Smooth, mobile-optimized checkout experience.
  • Secure Transactions: PCI DSS compliance with end-to-end encryption.
  • Real-Time Order Updates: Instant order status synchronization.
  • Fast Integration: Easy setup without coding skills.
  • Razorpay Sign-up: Highlighted Razorpay sign-up option for new customers.

Why Choose Razorpay?

  • Increase Conversions: Fast UPI payments reduce cart abandonment rates.
  • Trusted & Secure: One of India’s most trusted payment methods.
  • Quick Settlements: Receive payments faster with low transaction fees.
  • Wide Reach: Accept payments from millions of Razorpay users.
  • Exclusive Benefits for Razorpay Merchants: Enjoy special offers for Razorpay business account holders.

Razorpay is supported for transactions within India and in INR currency only.

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the plugin.
  2. Enter your Razorpay API Key & Secret in WooCommerce settings.
  3. Enable Razorpay as a payment method in WooCommerce.
  4. Customers can now pay using UPI, Cards, Net Banking, and Wallets securely!

That’s it! Your WooCommerce store is now powered by Razorpay!

External Services

This plugin integrates with Razorpay to process payments and onboard merchants.

It connects to the following Razorpay services:

  • https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js
    Used to render the Razorpay payment form during checkout.

  • https://api.razorpay.com/v1/
    Used to create and verify orders, process payments, and handle webhooks.

  • https://rzp.io/
    Used during merchant onboarding to link or register a Razorpay account.

Data Sent:
– For payments: customer name, email, phone number, order ID, order amount, currency, billing/shipping address.
– For onboarding: merchant email, phone, and account information required by Razorpay.

These services are essential for secure payment transactions and Razorpay account setup.

Service Provider: Razorpay Software Private Limited
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy

Support & Feedback

📩 Need help? Visit our support page.
🌟 Enjoying the plugin? Leave us a review!

License

For more details, see GPL-2.0 License.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support UPI payments?

Yes! Customers can pay via UPI seamlessly, making transactions fast and secure.

Do I need a Razorpay account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a Razorpay merchant account to generate API credentials. You can sign up here.

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, this plugin is 100% free, but Razorpay’s standard transaction fees apply based on your pricing plan.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No! The plugin is lightweight & optimized for fast performance.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes! Razorpay is PCI DSS Level 1 compliant, ensuring secure payment processing.
